Asked by the owner 2026-10-28 ('Have all rules in the runbook including the updated ones recently been mechanically enforeced?'); steps 1-3 approved 2026-10-28T16:50:12Z.
line_citations_note: line and file:line citations are as of HEAD 5be43a655; the runbook is unchanged since (git diff 5be43a655 HEAD at 7730b4319), other files have moved
method: six read-only reviewer agents split the runbook and classified each rule against the code; rows re-checked by hand on 2026-10-28 all held; census tickets S6-B3337 to S6-B3341 re-derived at HEAD 7730b4319

rows.rule: The runbook names no registered strategy; strategy-specific records live in STRATEGY_CAMPAIGN_LOG.md.
rows.evidence: Regex built from every ALL_STRATEGIES name (strat_ prefix optional); asserts named(text)==[] on the live runbook and must-fire on a real name. GATE-tier test_unit, so naming a strategy fails the pyramid.

rows.rule: The runbook names no family, config or campaign; an open family instance is a queue ticket, never named here (restated line 267).
rows.evidence: The denylist is 21 fixed tokens (sw#sp#, SMC_/CANDLE_/INST_/PEAD_ knobs, smc, pead, candle, breaker, top_decile...). Unlisted family words (lever4, pairs, camarilla) and ticket ids pass. Grep 'class-level|names no strategy' in scripts/: no other check.

rows.rule: Every heading carries its pre-restructure anchor as '(formerly §x)' so old citations resolve by search.
rows.evidence: The test asserts five specific 'formerly' anchors only (11.2c, 11.2w, 11.2b2d, STEP 3.1-3.4, 10.1); no per-heading check exists. Headings 0, 0.2 and 0.4 carry no tag.

rows.rule: APPENDIX M maps every section of the archived pre-B3096 runbook to its new home.
rows.evidence: Collects every heading line number of the archived runbook (outside code fences) and asserts APPENDIX M's numbered rows equal that list exactly; a missing or extra row fails the gate.

rows.rule: Measured instances, dated slates and a family's knob values go in STRATEGY_CAMPAIGN_LOG.md; this runbook states only the class rule.
rows.evidence: The pin catches strategy names and family knob prefixes only; a dated slate, a measured count or a bare knob value passes. Grep STRATEGY_CAMPAIGN_LOG in scripts/: only build_strategy_status's reader and a fix-gate artifact list.

rows.rule: Step windows and universes come from the parsed §1.2 table; a spec declaring its step may not type window, tickers_file or universe.
rows.mechanism: phase_table.spec_refusals scripts/phase_table.py:224-229 via launch_refusals producer_variant_table.py:6420-6426; run_wave.resolve_ruled_scope run_wave.py:180-204
rows.evidence: run_wave.main runs launch_refusals (:798) then injects the resolved window (:812). Escapes: grandfathered legacy specs (_legacy_typed_specs.json) and a no-step spec with a 20+ character waiver (phase_table.py:215-234). test_b3096 ties the §0.1 rows to the parsed table.

rows.rule: Step 0 builds the SPECS entry (formula, Table A) before Step 1; launch refuses an unregistered strategy (B2578, restated §0.4 line 170).
rows.evidence: Refuses no SPECS entry, PHASE0-only or non-battery-family strategies; called at run_wave.py:798, prelaunch_gate.py:133, make_spec.py:593. validate_spec demands formula/Table A agreement (:5323-5331); offline Step-1 tools refuse unregistered strategies.

rows.rule: Step 1 SEARCH ranks combinations in-sample only, as a ranked list with no gates (owner ruling B1608).
rows.evidence: The offline sweep reads rc.in_sample only and ranks by IS Sharpe with no verdict; engine Step-1 windows past 2025-05-05 are refused when resolved or typed. Step-1 tables state no row can PASS (producer_variant_table.py:7763).

rows.rule: The Step-2 holdout read (one-way door) happens only on the owner's own explicit word, every time (restated §0.6 line 200).
rows.evidence: Pins the VALIDATE row's text. offline_holdout_read.py main (:267-279) takes no ruling; engine Step 2 via make_spec/run_wave needs none; wave_identity.step2_rerun_refusal (:202-220) guards only a repeat. Only breadth_step2_read requires --ruling.

rows.rule: Step 3 BREADTH is offline and never launches the engine; phase_table.resolve(3) refuses.
rows.evidence: Any step name outside {SEARCH, VALIDATE} raises; test_b3105_steps_are_keyed_on_name (test_unit.py:46712-46730) proves resolve(3) and a step-3 spec refuse. A breadth axis gets no resim level without an engine-read env knob (validate_spec :5387-5407).

rows.rule: The breadth holdout read covers exactly the registered Step-1 cells, never re-derived.
rows.evidence: Cells are taken from the cited Step-1 artifact's rows; the read also refuses a Step-1 artifact whose multiplicity block is absent or not reconciled.

rows.rule: A qualifier enters the Phase 1B roster only on the owner's own ruling per admission or an explicit standing scope (restated §0.6 line 201).
rows.evidence: The gate test renders the real admissions file; the render dereferences adm['ruled'] and adm['ruling_verbatim'] (KeyError when absent) and refuses a non-PASS row. Presence only: empty or invented words pass; phase1b_membership counts admissions without checking rulings.

rows.rule: Only SEARCH and VALIDATE resolve a window; phase_table.resolve refuses every other step by name.
rows.evidence: ENGINE_STEPS = {SEARCH, VALIDATE}; any other row name raises SystemExit. test_b3105_steps_are_keyed_on_name (test_unit.py:46712-46718) asserts resolve(0), resolve(3) and resolve(4) refuse.

rows.rule: The manifest records the resolved step NAME beside its number.
rows.evidence: _resolved_scope carries step and name and the generated manifest copies step plus _resolved_scope; test_unit.py:46731-46732 asserts the name is SEARCH for a step-1 spec.

rows.rule: Sub-steps are numbered inside their step; workflow ids are lettered (T, L, F, R, D) and battery checks are 'battery step N'.
rows.evidence: test_b3096 numbering() checks only '## N.' and '### N.M' headings (test_unit.py:44980-45005). Grep 'battery step|T0-T8|L0-L8|R1-R10|D1-D6' in test_unit.py: none; in scripts/ only docstring usages.

rows.rule: '§' always marks a section of this document, never a step.
rows.evidence: refs() fails only a § reference resolving to no heading; a § used for a step whose number matches a heading (e.g. §2.2 for Step 2.2) passes. Grep 'never a step|marks a section' across *.py: no check.

rows.rule: The two pre-B3096 step numberings are retired and must not be used.
rows.evidence: Only a heading in this runbook starting 'STEP 3.' or 'STEP 4.' is refused; retired numbering in prose, queue rows or other documents passes.

rows.rule: Write every new step reference as number AND name ('Step 4 ADMIT'), never a bare number.
rows.evidence: Grep 'number AND name|bare number|Step 4 ADMIT' in scripts/ and test_unit.py: no check. The slice itself writes bare 'Step 1' and 'Step 2' (lines 140, 198-200).

rows.rule: The breadth holdout read runs only on the owner's explicit word; breadth_step2_read.py refuses without --ruling.
rows.evidence: Claim verified; an AST pin in test_b3105 (test_unit.py:46762-46771) keeps --ruling required. The words are recorded as ruling_verbatim (:285) but nothing can verify they are the owner's.

rows.evidence: --prior-read is required with no default and a named prior read needs the owner's --disclosure words; the label follows. A false 'none' is not cross-checked against any record of earlier reads.

rows.rule: Optional is never silent: the Step 4 ADMIT proposal records Step 3 BREADTH as RAN or N/A with the reason.
rows.evidence: Asserts the §6 sentence only. build_phase_1b_roster.py has no Step-3 disposition field or check (grep 'breadth|step3|RAN': none of that kind). breadth_step2_read requires --breadth-disposition on breadth reads only (:128-152).

rows.rule: Tighten levels live in free_band and loosen levels in resim_band; validate_spec enforces that the two partition each band exactly, with no overlap.
rows.mechanism: validate_spec producer_variant_table.py:5357-5368; called by launch_refusals :6511 and renders :7853, :7924
rows.evidence: Claim verified; mutation pin test_unit.py:30357-30366. Unchecked until launch: SPECS_PHASE0 drafts, e.g. smc_order_block_bounce P1 resim omits 20 (:676), and test_b2870 holds PHASE0 non-clean by design. Offline sweeps never call validate_spec.

rows.rule: Lane follows STREAM: TIGHTEN to W-T, LOOSEN to W-L, BOTH W-T first then W-L only if T4 ranked nothing, NONE to breadth.
rows.evidence: Nothing routes or refuses: launch_refusals (producer_variant_table.py:6343-6604) has no stream check; grep 'rankable|W-T first' in scripts/ finds only tighten_breaker_block.step1_rankable, unrelated.

rows.rule: Every per-strategy campaign has two legs, depth and breadth, each run or explicitly waived with a recorded reason.
rows.evidence: For depth-only campaigns the text pin is all: offline_holdout_read and engine Step 2 record no leg disposition. breadth_step2_read refuses without --breadth-disposition ran/waived plus a waiver reason (:128-152).

rows.rule: The DEPTH leg is Priority 1 and mandatory: it covers ALL Table A producer bands, resim included; the venue never narrows it.
rows.mechanism: SKILL.md fragment pin (L785), test_unit.py:25942; partial: offline_holdout_read.py:112-146
rows.evidence: The offline T6 read refuses while any Table A level is untested (band_coverage_gate.coverage_report). Engine Step 2 has no coverage check: grep band_coverage in run_wave.py, run_postconfig.py and launch_refusals finds none.

rows.rule: Axes an offline venue cannot reach are resim-SCHEDULED or owner-WAIVED in words at band review.
rows.evidence: band_coverage_gate counts any level in a Step-1 artifact's discarded_levels as tested (:14-15, :190-191) with no owner-words field; grep 'waive|ruling' in band_coverage_gate.py finds docstrings and a refusal message (:438) only.

rows.rule: For a TIGHTEN-lane strategy the producer-band resim legs are in-mandate and run in that lane after its offline legs.
rows.evidence: No lane or ordering check; the nearest gate, offline_holdout_read's coverage refusal (:132-146), accepts discarded_levels instead of a resim run. Grep 'in-mandate|B2843' in scripts/: only a build_table_a comment (:816).

rows.rule: No campaign closes while a mandatory leg is unrun.
rows.mechanism: none at closure; opt-in CLI band_coverage_gate --declare-step2-failure :423-441
rows.evidence: Closure records are read without coverage checks (build_strategy_status.py:692-710, :757-792); breadth_step2_read only labels 'NO FAILURE VERDICT' (:275-280). Grep band_coverage: preflight.py none, verify_turn_compliance.py a docstring (:1610).

rows.rule: Every disposition names the legs run and not run (CHECKLIST #299 / L785).
rows.mechanism: none for ledger or campaign-log dispositions
rows.evidence: breadth_step2_read (:281-287) and offline_holdout_read (:213) stamp band_coverage into their own artifacts; grep '#299|legs run' in verify_turn_compliance.py finds docstrings only (:1505, :1610).

rows.rule: The band-coverage gate is the depth-leg mechanism, and Step-1 discards count as testing.
rows.evidence: discarded_levels from Step-1 artifacts are unioned with graded and resim-evidenced levels before a level is called untested; the module docstring quotes the owner ruling that discards count.

rows.rule: A campaign spec queued before a template change is re-checked against the template at execution.
rows.evidence: launch_refusals re-runs code-encoded checks at launch (run_wave.py:798) and the window re-resolves (:812), but nothing compares a queued campaign with the runbook's campaign template; read launch_refusals body (producer_variant_table.py:6343-6604): no such check.

rows.rule: One owner-worded Step-2 holdout read per campaign; a re-read must be declared.
rows.evidence: Both guards key on the same output path or wave name and clear with --force-rerun or the copied digest token; a re-read under a new --out or wave name runs unlabelled. Grep 'spent holdout|holdout_spent' in scripts/: only these guards.

rows.rule: A breadth axis's lift is attributed to the signal only after the same axis is swept on a control family; run or waive per campaign.
rows.evidence: The breadth Step-2 read computes control lift on every all-six qualifier against a fixed default control; breadth_step1_grid has no control (grep 'control': none); attribution prose and waivers are unchecked.

rows.rule: next_pivot_target is barred as a selected exit; use the best non-npt exit that clears the gates.
rows.mechanism: test_b2671, test_unit.py:36460; partial bars in breadth and family Step-1 tools
rows.evidence: Barred at breadth_step1_grid.py:376, breadth_step2_read.py:235, lever4_step1.py:80, smc_*_step1, table_d_render.py:802. Not in offline_level_sweep.py:390-394 (its best exit, npt included, becomes the pre-registered cell), offline_holdout_read.py or admissions.

rows.rule: Every owner-ruled admission set passes Jaccard-0.70 de-dup before the deployable count; canonical = highest holdout Sharpe; pruned rows keep an audit trail.
rows.evidence: Code de-dups only funnel cells, canonical by IS Sharpe (build_phase_1b_roster.py:774-794); admissions render without de-dup (:478-546); pruned_collinear_b2666 is a static list (build_strategy_status.py:841-843); phase1b_membership has no Jaccard.

rows.rule: Before consuming any number from the status view its build stamp must equal HEAD, else regenerate and commit; never plan from a stale or pasted copy.
rows.evidence: Pins the 'FRESHNESS PRECONDITION' text (restated line 237). Only the two offline Step-1 tools refuse a stale stamp; make_spec.py:87-114 reads the JSON with no freshness check, and planning from the view is unchecked.

rows.rule: The Step-1 instruments refuse to run on a missing or stale status-view stamp (step1_gates, S6-B2848b).
rows.evidence: Raises when the JSON build.source_commit is unreadable or differs from git HEAD; called at offline_level_sweep.py:573 and breadth_step1_grid.py:270. The engine Step-1 spec generator make_spec.py does not call it.

rows.rule: Take the owner's direction for the session; absent one, the default queue is W-T entry order.
rows.evidence: Grep 'entry order|default queue' in scripts/: none; build_long_campaign_shortlist.py ranks candidates but gates nothing; build_workflow_state.py is derivation for display only (its docstring).

rows.rule: Run the workflow step by step; every owner stop is a WAIT, not a skip.
rows.evidence: That scan only blocks closing a ticket whose earlier rows say an owner decision is owed, and any acknowledgement phrase clears it; nothing sequences workflow steps or detects a skipped owner stop.

rows.rule: Every workflow step leaves its named artifact.
rows.evidence: Grep 'named artifact' in *.py: verify_build_claims.py is a standalone audit imported nowhere (grep verify_build_claims in scripts/: none); build_workflow_state.py displays ledger state only.

rows.rule: An ambiguity that changes the work is put to the owner as a question.
rows.evidence: Grep 'ambiguity that changes' in scripts/: none; none of the scan_* functions in verify_turn_compliance.py (list read) keys on an unasked fork.

rows.rule: An assumption that survives is stated in the campaign row.
rows.evidence: Grep 'assumption that survives|STATED in the campaign row' across *.py: none; no scan_* function in verify_turn_compliance.py addresses assumptions.

rows.rule: After a mid-turn compaction, re-read the operative sections, the stamped view and every file about to be edited before the next substantive action.
rows.evidence: These demand a Skill(execution-discipline) call and a ticket-history read since the last compaction; nothing checks that runbook sections or the status view were re-read (grep 'status view|STATUS.md' in verify_turn_compliance.py: none).

rows.rule: An instruction covers steps only up to the next irreversible or owner-owned gate, never past it; the mandatory pre-execution check for every campaign.
rows.evidence: Behaviour is gated only at specific doors (breadth --ruling, offline Step-1 --band-ruling); the engine launch and the offline T6 read accept no owner word. Grep 'APPROVAL FLOW|one-way door' in test_unit.py: none.

rows.rule: The owner reviews the bands (Table A) before Step 1.
rows.mechanism: test_b2828 pin, test_unit.py:39221; partial: step1_gates.require_band_ruling step1_gates.py:29-57
rows.evidence: Offline Step-1 tools refuse without --band-ruling (offline_level_sweep.py:572, breadth_step1_grid.py:269), any non-empty text passing; engine Step 1 via make_spec/run_wave needs none (grep band_ruling hits only those tools and step1_gates).

rows.rule: Wiring a NEW-GATE into strategies or engine knobs needs per-strategy owner approval.
rows.evidence: Table A tags B-row candidates NEW-GATE; grep 'NEW-GATE' finds no hit in preflight.py or verify_turn_compliance.py, and preflight has no screener.py approval check.

rows.rule: Never launch the engine without the owner's launch word (standing).
rows.evidence: Grep 'launch word|launch_word|owner_launch' in scripts/: none. prelaunch_gate.py's owner references are the 5h cap (:188-246); run_wave.main gates on launch_refusals only; .claude/settings.json hooks are the heredoc guard, tier3 inject and Stop compliance.

rows.rule: Read the status view before naming ANY strategy, family or batch as work to start.
rows.evidence: Pins the L802 SKILL.md tripwire row; the test docstring says detection is JUDGMENT-ONLY. Grep 'status view|L802' in verify_turn_compliance.py: none.

rows.rule: Each strategy carries exactly one status from the vocabulary (runbook: eleven, eight terminal plus three lanes), partitioning all registered strategies.
rows.evidence: One status per ALL_STRATEGIES name by fixed precedence. Runbook stale: the code has twelve - TERMINAL_STATUSES adds CLOSED-NO-READ (:664-675, S6-B3303, 2026-10-26).

rows.rule: The view's ticket column carries the campaign's tickets from the owner-opened register.
rows.evidence: The JSON 'tickets' field comes from the register. The markdown view renders no ticket column (header :1339 ends at exit cube), so the runbook's column list is stale.

rows.rule: STREAM is assigned mechanically as TIGHTEN, LOOSEN, BOTH or NONE.
rows.evidence: Tightenable with a projection under the 100-fire floor gives BOTH, else TIGHTEN, LOOSEN or NONE; terminal rows get '-'.

rows.rule: This section quotes no live totals; counts live only in the stamped view (per-family counts in the campaign log).
rows.evidence: Asserts the phrase 'COUNTS LIVE IN THE STAMPED VIEW, NEVER HERE' exists; nothing scans §0.7 for numbers.

rows.rule: Terminal statuses are mutually exclusive with every work lane.
rows.evidence: A terminal row gets stream '-' and is dropped from the open population before the stream and family counts.

rows.rule: IN-CAMPAIGN requires an owner-opened register record with a ticket whose current ledger state is non-terminal.
rows.evidence: Live means OPEN, BLOCKED, DEFERRED or RUNNING via queue_state; test_b2829 (test_unit.py:39263-39267) re-checks every IN-CAMPAIGN row of the committed JSON against the ledger.

rows.rule: A register row whose tickets are all terminal is STALLED-CAMPAIGN and keeps its stream lane and workflow eligibility.
rows.evidence: STALLED-CAMPAIGN sits in LANE_STATUSES, not TERMINAL_STATUSES (:664-675), so its stream is computed (:1113-1114); test_b3194 arm 2 (test_unit.py:58290-58302).

rows.rule: An unlisted strategy is NOT-STARTED whatever tickets mention it.
rows.evidence: No register record yields empty tickets, so status_for returns NOT-STARTED; test_b3194 arm 1 (test_unit.py:58275-58288) proves a campaign-worded live mention reads NOT-STARTED.

rows.rule: Lanes classify on the current-gate projection (raw projection times survives_pct).
rows.evidence: An unmeasured side keeps its raw share and a zero-fire row keeps raw; test_b2823_stream_is_classified_on_current_gate_fires (test_unit.py:39034) pins decisive committed rows.

rows.rule: reopen_candidate only flags a terminal row whose entry condition moved; nothing reopens automatically.
rows.evidence: The flag is a boolean on the record; status_for (:913-949) never reads it, so the status stays terminal.

rows.rule: Reopening (re-testing) a terminal strategy is the owner's word.
rows.evidence: Roster members are refused at launch and at offline holdout reads without owner override words. CLOSED-NEGATIVE, PRUNED-DUPLICATE, CONTAINED, CLOSED-NO-READ and non-roster DONE-OWNER-CLOSED names sit outside that set (phase1b_admitted :6031-6106), so nothing refuses re-testing them.

rows.rule: The view prints the caveats bounding its numbers: fire-logic upper bound, TIGHTEN lower bound, survives_pct semantics.
rows.evidence: Caveat text is emitted on every build; the fire-logic comparison strips docstrings and the _strat payload and raises on an unreadable R5 screener (:423-427); '-' prints only for zero-fire rows.

rows.rule: An owner-opened campaign is recorded in owner_campaign_opens.json the turn the owner opens it, then the view is rebuilt.
rows.evidence: Grep 'campaign_opens|owner_campaign' in scripts/: only build_strategy_status.py reads the register; no Stop-hook scan or preflight check ties an owner opening to a same-turn record or rebuild.

rows.rule: Each register record carries strategy, opened date, owner's words and a non-empty tickets list; the reader raises on a malformed, unreadable or duplicate register.
rows.evidence: Claim verified: raises on unreadable JSON, no 'opens' list, a missing strategy, date, words or tickets, empty tickets, or a duplicate; test_b3194 strict-reader arms (test_unit.py:58339 on).

rows.rule: The register is the only source of IN-CAMPAIGN and STALLED-CAMPAIGN; ticket mentions feed only mention_tickets.
rows.evidence: main() binds tickets and live_tickets once, from register_tickets; campaign_tickets output feeds only the mention list; the AST test fails on any second binding.

rows.rule: Which members a family campaign records is the owner's word, ruled per family.
rows.evidence: Each member record must carry ruling_verbatim or ruling_in_substance or the build raises; presence only, nothing checks that the words rule on that member.

rows.rule: The closure register mirrors the open register and outranks it.
rows.evidence: An owner-closed name returns DONE-OWNER-CLOSED before any lane status; load_owner_closures raises on a missing strategy, date or words, or a duplicate (:692-710).

rows.rule: The holdout window is locked to R5's dates, 2025-05-05 -> 2026-05-05 (1 year); no logic may move it.
rows.mechanism: roster_core.py:56-57 single definition; test_b3139bc; test_b2711 + test_b3105 (start); roster_core.metric_code_fingerprint :397-420
rows.evidence: Start is pinned (pvt IS_HO_BOUNDARY=='2025-05-05'; phase_table boundary==rc.HO_START) and hand-typed window copies are banned. HO_END/duration has no value pin (test_b1800 only asserts HO_END > 2025-08-01); moving it only re-stamps metric_code.

rows.rule: The holdout is read only at Step 2 - never during Step-1 search, per iteration, or to check progress.
rows.evidence: Resolver refuses a Step-1 window ending past 2025-05-05, typed past-boundary windows are refused, and offline_level_sweep has no holdout code (AST pin). Escapes: the 66 legacy-register spec names skip the shape check (pvt:5890); M4 only flags after the run.

rows.rule: Each object's holdout is read once: one read per offline campaign, one per engine Step-2 config; a completed read is not re-run.
rows.evidence: The offline read refuses an existing --out (--force-rerun labels RERUN_OF_SPENT_HOLDOUT); run_wave refuses re-running a COMPLETE step-2 wave unless the spec carries the summary digest token (not owner words). A new --out path or wave name escapes.

rows.rule: Under the engine waterfall, Step-2 configs are read in turn and stop at the first qualifier.
rows.evidence: Searched 'waterfall|first qualifier|QUALIF|stop condition' and 'PASS|verdict|step2' in run_serial_chain.py (no match) and 'waterfall.{0,60}(stop|halt|qualif)' across scripts (one roster_core.py:304 comment). The chain runs every spec it is given.

rows.rule: After a read the holdout is spent: a ranking re-derived afterwards is a candidate, never a verdict.
rows.evidence: Only the pre-registered cell is admission-bearing; every other line is labelled peeked with a 'none can be promoted' note. Nothing blocks promoting one - admissions are hand-recorded owner rulings in phase_1b_step2_admissions.json.

rows.rule: The search space (signals, thresholds, objective) is written to EXECUTION_QUEUE.md and committed before any score is computed.
rows.evidence: Searched '(prereg|pre-reg|preregistration).{0,80}(commit|git)' in scripts (docstrings only: b2701_smc_lsr_step2, grade_family_siblings) and 'prereg' in verify_turn_compliance.py and run_serial_chain.py (none). No sweep or launcher checks a queue row or commit before scoring.

rows.rule: The Step-2 cell is committed before any holdout code path runs.
rows.mechanism: none (cell derived by construction: offline_holdout_read.py:85, make_spec.py:590)
rows.evidence: The read takes the cell from the Step-1 artifact and make_spec copies the Step-1 rank-1 exit, but nothing checks git status; drift_allowed accepts changed output_audit *.json mid-wave (launch_sweep.py:214-217). Searched 'committed before|prereg' in producer_variant_table.py, run_serial_chain.py.

rows.rule: The exit choice is made on in-sample rows only: select_exit slices in_sample() itself.
rows.evidence: select_exit calls in_sample(g) first (line 486); the runbook's :345-357 cite is stale. Pin is weak: test_b1800 arm 2 pre-slices with in_sample and arm 4 only asserts the neutralised filter selects, so removing the internal slice would not fail it.

rows.rule: Step 1 ranks on is_sharpe / is_ci_lo, never on the holdout key.
rows.evidence: test_b2010 code-pins tighten's (-is_ci_lo, -is_sharpe) sort; offline_level_sweep sorts on is_sharpe with no holdout code; Step-1 engine cubes contain no holdout rows. Other registry graders' sort keys are unpinned but see no holdout data.

rows.rule: Never claim a mechanism that does not exist; an acknowledged gap is preferred.
rows.evidence: scan_unverified_structure (verify_turn_compliance.py:1230) only requires some file opened in-turn for 'is wired'-type claims; nothing checks runbook mechanism claims - e.g. this slice's 'battery FAILS a cube without [a receipt]' is false (M10 SKIPs).

rows.rule: Every reported number ships with its diagnostics: sensitivity curve, leave-one-out contribution, churn (in/out) and effective breadth.
rows.evidence: Searched 'sensitivity[_ ]curve|leave[_ -]one[_ -]out|#175|#176' and 'churn' in scripts: only a roster gate-LOO table (build_phase_1b_roster.py:881) and N_eff from a static artifact; no sensitivity or churn producer and no report check.

rows.rule: There is no usable prior: earlier results are motivation, never a numerical expectation of a strategy's outcome.
rows.evidence: Searched 'base rate|usable prior|R6b' in scripts and verify_turn_compliance.py: only unrelated base-rate analyses and roster cube labels; no scan or gate inspects reported expectations.

rows.rule: Count holdout reads project-wide (the L351 discipline).
rows.evidence: Searched 'holdout_reads|count_holdout_reads|holdout_read_ledger' and 'previously_read|prior_read' in scripts: only breadth_step2_read records the subject's own prior read (--prior-read, :135-162); no project-wide counter or ledger exists.

rows.rule: Each step's window and universe come from the parsed phase table, and its content hash is stamped into every step-declaring spec's manifest.
rows.evidence: resolve() returns window, tickers_file and a 16-hex table sha; run_wave injects them after the launch gate passes and stamps _resolved_scope. A spec without step passes through unchanged, as the runbook says.

rows.rule: Edit a phase-table row only on an owner ruling.

rows.rule: L8: the variant cube stays in the registry for every future campaign's L2 lookup.
rows.evidence: No registry exists: landings commit audit artifacts, never the cube dir (run_phase1a.py:194). Searched 'glob(.*run_manifest' and 'resim_configs' writers in scripts: no lookup tool or retention guard.

rows.rule: Commit a measured producer-reach map output_audit/<batch>_<family>_producer_map.json; a family without one builds it at L0.
rows.evidence: Searched 'producer_map|reach.map' in scripts (only build_strategy_producer_map.py writing strategy_producer_map.csv) and 'producer_map.json' in test_unit.py: none. Nothing reads a per-family map at spec or launch.

rows.rule: The resim subset excludes ADMITTED strategies; the launch gate refuses them (B2731).

rows.rule: The resim subset excludes every B2825 terminal status.
rows.evidence: Only Phase-1B roster names are refused. Searched 'CLOSED-NEGATIVE|TERMINAL_STATUSES|owner_campaign_closures|status_for' and 'STALLED-CAMPAIGN|NOT-STARTED' in launch-path scripts: none; CLOSED-NEGATIVE, DONE-OWNER-CLOSED, CLOSED-NO-READ, DISABLED, PRUNED-DUPLICATE, CONTAINED escape.

rows.rule: The variant's identity is carried in the cube dir name and every landed cube's manifest.
rows.evidence: Out dir is output_<wave>_<tag>; the manifest embeds the arm with its env knob values, input_names and the spec's step for every launch through run_wave.

rows.rule: The resim persists signals_at_entry as standard.

rows.rule: The leverage line divides engine hours by the open-consumer count.

rows.rule: Windows and universes are the ruled shapes: Step 1 200 tickers x 1 year; Steps 2-3 4 years x 544.
rows.evidence: run_wave injects window and universe for step-declaring specs (run_wave.py:180-204) after launch_refusals refuses typed scope (6420-6426). Exempt by design: a 66-name legacy register and a >=20-char waiver string, not verified as owner words.

rows.rule: IN-CAMPAIGN rows belong to their tickets.

rows.rule: Reopening a terminal strategy is the owner's word on a reopen_candidate flag, never a workflow step.

rows.rule: Before any launch, classify every parameter against signals_at_entry: persisted = FREE, producer-internal = ENGINE (free_band/resim_band).
rows.evidence: Partition is checked only where a param declares a band split (skip at 5358-5359); persistence is never tested. Searched 'signals_at_entry' in producer_variant_table.py (prose only) and 'Classify every parameter' in tests: none.

rows.rule: Put the leverage figure and its basis in the spec note and the launch turn before any launch.
rows.evidence: Searched 'leverage' in verify_turn_compliance.py, run_wave.py, launch_sweep.py, make_spec.py (none) and 'Publish leverage|spec note and the launch turn' in tests (none). make_spec writes no leverage field.

rows.rule: Site the baseline at the loosest admissible level of every persisted gate.
rows.evidence: Searched 'loosest' in scripts (candle_grid_feasibility.py, feasibility_rung.py prose only) and 'LOOSEST admissible' in tests: none. No spec field or check places the baseline.

rows.rule: Depth by coordinate descent as the default; a full factorial needs a stated reason.
rows.evidence: No pass orchestration; make_spec --with builds factorial cells with no reason field (make_spec.py:483-499). Searched 'coordinate.descent|factorial_reason|joint.optimum' in scripts (none) and 'COORDINATE DESCENT' in test_unit.py (only test_b2824's docstring).

rows.rule: After descent converges, run one confirmation config at the predicted joint optimum if new; record predicted-vs-measured in the campaign row.
rows.evidence: Asserts the clause text inside 4.4. No code computes a predicted optimum, schedules the confirmation run or checks the record (searched 'joint.optimum|interaction.check|predicted.vs.measured' in scripts: unrelated hit only).

rows.rule: A material predicted-vs-measured gap re-opens the full-grid question for that family.
rows.evidence: Asserts 're-opens the full-grid question' text only; nothing measures the gap or flags the family.

rows.rule: Breadth runs free on the winning line only.
rows.evidence: Searched 'winning line|winning_line|on the winning' in scripts and 'Breadth runs free on the winning line' in tests: none. No check restricts where breadth grids run.

rows.rule: One Step-2 read, then the campaign closes.
rows.evidence: Blocks only re-running the same wave name over a COMPLETE step-2 summary; a renamed wave re-reads the holdout unrefused and nothing closes the campaign. Searched 'waterfall' in scripts (comments only) and the rule text in tests (none).

rows.rule: Before building, run verify_universe_artifact.py on the tickers file against the baseline cube; it must print 'looks like a broad universe'.

rows.rule: Read memory headroom as COMMIT, never working set alone.
rows.evidence: Free commit is logged at each leg start and stored in leg_outcomes (564); nothing refuses a launch on low commit; commit_watchdog.py is called by no launch-path script (searched 'commit_free|commit_watchdog').

rows.rule: Re-deriving the concurrency ceiling on commit is an owner call.
rows.evidence: The runbook assigns the decision to the owner and claims no mechanism; none found.

rows.rule: Confirm the sweep knobs differ across concurrent launches.
rows.evidence: arm_env_matches compares a manifest with its own environment, never launches with each other. Searched 'identical|duplicate|S6-B1576b' in run_wave/launch_sweep/prelaunch_gate/run_serial_chain/launch_detached and launch_sweep's def list: no cross-launch comparison.

rows.rule: An unset or mismatched arm env value is refused.
rows.evidence: Exit 2 before the engine when a declared arm env key is unset or differs in the live environment; skipped only under the --engine-cmd test seam.

rows.rule: One strategy per graded subset (riders aside).
rows.evidence: A multi-strategy graded subset without declared riders launches, then the battery FAILs step 1 at landing (post-spend), blocking the ledger gate; make_spec writes a one-name subset (519-521).

rows.rule: The Step-1 search universe is output_audit/_sweep_200.txt, shared by every strategy.
rows.evidence: run_wave injects _sweep_200.txt for every step-1 spec (run_wave.py:180-204); a different typed tickers_file is refused (also spec_refusals 224-229) unless a waiver string is present.

rows.rule: Rebuild _sweep_200 only if the 544 universe changes.
rows.evidence: No content hash of _sweep_200.txt is pinned across waves; launch_sweep.drift_check pins it only within one wave (launch_sweep.py:296-302). Searched '_sweep_200' in test_unit.py (paths only) and 'Rebuild ONLY' in tests (none).

rows.rule: Select the Step-1 list by ADV over the warmup window 2021-05-06..2022-05-05, fixed, never per-strategy.
rows.evidence: The builder ranks the 544 by ADV inside WARMUP_LO..WARMUP_HI with MIN_WARMUP_BARS=100 and takes no strategy input, and phase_table hands every strategy the same file.

rows.rule: Detect status=complete, trades=0 runs independently of the ledger (zero_output_runs).

rows.rule: Monitors must not count against the ticker file; the screener reports against the PIT-active universe.
rows.evidence: Blocks a turn whose searching CronCreate names no positive-control cue; it checks the cue word only, not that the pattern matched a real line.

rows.rule: Arm the monitor before the launch, in the same turn.
rows.evidence: Stop hook exits 2 when a runner launch (launch_detached included) has no hourly, unconditional CronCreate this turn. Order is unchecked: an arm placed after the launch also passes.

rows.rule: Write one spec per fire-adding config.
rows.evidence: run_wave runs every arm a spec lists (run_wave.py:813-814). Searched 'len(...arms|arms[1]|one arm' in launch-path scripts and the refusal lists of launch_refusals/prelaunch_gate: no arm limit. make_spec happens to emit one arm per spec.

rows.rule: Copy this family's own latest Step-1 spec, never another family's, changing only knob values and names.
rows.evidence: No template-provenance field or comparison. Searched 'template' in verify_turn_compliance.py and preflight.py: none. Foreign env keys are refused as undeclared (6585-6589), but edits to pool_workers, leg_cap_hours or max_legs pass.

rows.rule: Declare step 1 and leave step1_cube at its default TRUE.
rows.evidence: make_spec sets both (make_spec.py:541-544). Searched 'step1_cube' in launch-path scripts: run_wave maps false to --step2-cube (628) with no cross-check against step; launch_refusals never reads it.

rows.rule: Diff the spec against its template in the turn (the must-leave artifact).
rows.evidence: Searched 'template|diff.*spec' in verify_turn_compliance.py and 'spec.*template|must-leave' in preflight.py: no gate or artifact check.

rows.rule: Launch the chain detached via launch_detached.py --chain, the only sanctioned chain path.
rows.evidence: run_serial_chain runs from a console with a console_ id (run_serial_chain.py:305) and run_wave is callable directly (wave_identity.py:45-49). Searched 'ONLY sanctioned' in tests and 'around-the-gate|S6-B2159b' in scripts: no launcher-identity refusal.

rows.rule: Never type tickers_file or the window in a spec; phase_table injects them and spec_refusals refuses a typed window.
rows.evidence: A step-declaring spec typing window/tickers_file/universe/start/end is refused; an unimportable resolver also refuses. Exempt: the legacy register and a no-step spec carrying a >=20-char waiver string.

rows.rule: Every engine flag is derived from the spec by run_wave and checked by prelaunch_gate through launch_sweep.
rows.evidence: Engine args and env (pool_workers, window, leg_cap_hours, subset file, arm env) come from the spec; launch_sweep runs prelaunch_gate on the generated manifest and writes a gate receipt before the engine.

rows.rule: launch_refusals refuses an unregistered strategy or an off-band knob before the engine.
rows.evidence: Refuses a strategy in neither registry or PHASE0-only, a non-battery family, and an arm level outside the band; called by run_wave.py:798 and prelaunch_gate.py:132-134.

rows.rule: chain_task_running refuses a second chain.
rows.evidence: Refuses only when a stockpicks_chain_<batch>_* task with the SAME batch id is Running; a second chain under another batch id launches concurrently.

rows.rule: The chain's task unregisters itself at CHAIN DONE.
rows.evidence: launch_detached passes --task-name into the .cmd (launch_detached.py:182, 233-235); CHAIN DONE calls cleanup. A halted chain's task stays registered until a manual --cleanup.

rows.rule: One independent detached invocation per arm, never a shared shell-function wrapper.
rows.evidence: Searched 'shell.function|S6-B1535b|EXIT=127|wrapper function' in scripts and 'One INDEPENDENT detached|shared shell-function wrapper' in test_unit.py: none.

rows.rule: Always launch with an explicit interpreter path, never a bare python from a script.
rows.evidence: The sanctioned launchers never spawn a bare python. Backstop scan_bare_python_launch (verify_turn_compliance.py:5273-5314) blocks an inline subprocess(['python'...]) but strips heredoc bodies and never reads script files.

rows.rule: Never launch the direct engine command around the gate.
rows.evidence: A receipt-less cube is labelled SKIP, not FAIL, although launch_sweep.py:600-601 says run_postconfig FAILs it; prelaunch_gate.py:23-25 records direct run_phase1a launches bypass the gate, 'ticketed, not closed'.

rows.rule: STRATEGY_SUBSET_FILE is mandatory for optimisation runs.
rows.evidence: A spec without strategy_subset is refused (require_subset=True from run_wave.py:798); run_wave always exports STRATEGY_SUBSET_FILE to the engine (514).

rows.evidence: A subset run lacking cube flags (agents on, the Phase-1B shape) halts, but a full-roster 1a-beta cube run carrying a subset file passes. Searched 'full.roster|Phase 1B' in run_phase1a.py and 'STRATEGY_SUBSET_FILE' in backtest/: no other check.

rows.rule: Set DEMAND_PRUNING=0 only after a SkippedSignalError, raising DEMAND_PRUNING_WARMUP first.
rows.evidence: Searched 'SkippedSignalError|DEMAND_PRUNING_WARMUP' in scripts (none) and 'DEMAND_PRUNING' (A/B shell scripts and a docstring). As an arm env key it is refused as undeclared (6585-6589); an ambient value passes through run_wave's env (501).

rows.rule: Total workers never exceed the box's physical cores.
rows.evidence: The engine caps one run's pool at logical mp.cpu_count() (backtest/engine/backtest.py:2319-2322). Searched 'cpu_count|physical.cores' in launch-path scripts and 'pool_workers' in prelaunch_gate/launch_sweep/producer_variant_table: no total check.

rows.rule: The runner refuses to start without --max-run-hours.
rows.evidence: Exits 2 for --phase 1a-beta when --max-run-hours is absent; run_wave always passes the spec's leg_cap_hours (run_wave.py:484).

rows.rule: The 1-year Step-1 search window ends at the holdout boundary.
rows.evidence: A typed end past 2025-05-05 is refused even with a waiver; the battery FAILs a Step-1 cube holding holdout entries (M4_holdout_touch, run_postconfig.py:181-184).

rows.rule: Run configs as separate processes rather than widening the pool.
rows.evidence: pool_workers is a free spec field passed straight through (run_wave.py:482). Searched 'pool_workers' in prelaunch_gate/launch_sweep/producer_variant_table/run_serial_chain/launch_detached and 'cpu_count|physical.cores' in launch path: none.

rows.rule: Watch the log for MemoryError.
rows.mechanism: run_wave leg outcome + chain HALT, scripts/run_wave.py:554-568; run_serial_chain.py:384-389
rows.evidence: No MemoryError scan on the chain path (searched 'MemoryError' in scripts: legacy AWS/laptop monitors only); a crashed leg surfaces as a non-COMPLETE status and a reported chain HALT.

rows.rule: Completion is the cube artifact, never a percentage.
rows.evidence: COMPLETE only when trade_exit_detail.csv exists with more than one data row; run_serial_chain halts on anything else (384-389).

rows.rule: On completion verify the cube exists and every entry carries exactly len(EXIT_STRATEGIES) exits at the cube's SHA.
rows.evidence: cube_exists FAILs when absent; M2 FAILs unless a single exits-per-entry count equals the registry or a legacy 24/25/26; any such FAIL makes step 1 FAIL (1410-1416) and the ledger gate blocks.

rows.rule: On completion check entries per ticker against the baseline rate.
rows.evidence: Searched 'per.ticker|baseline rate|entries_per_ticker' in run_postconfig.py (none) and across scripts (only universe_ladder_run.py:91-94, a different launcher).

rows.rule: On completion count gradability: how many combinations produced a verdict.
rows.evidence: Every landing records the verdict with denominators via grid_population/ranked_count; reported, not gated.

rows.rule: Each landing's turn response carries LANDING REPORT: <cube>.
rows.evidence: Stop hook exits 2 while any postconfig_landings.jsonl event is unreported and the final response lacks the report string for that cube.

rows.rule: Every battery step ends DONE or N/A on evidence.
rows.evidence: Only DONE or N/A with non-empty evidence/reason closes a step; FAIL, OPEN and SKIPPED block the turn, as does a DONE step 2 missing its free-levels leg (leg2_gap).

rows.rule: A battery FAIL becomes a B-batch, not a footnote.
rows.evidence: A FAIL blocks closes until re-dispositioned, but an N/A with any reason clears it. Searched 'B-batch|classify_run_log|chain_halts' in the gate scripts (one docstring hit); scan_findings_vs_tickets counts response markers only (4033-4077).

rows.rule: On a chain HALT read serial_chain.log, run classify_run_log.py, read engine_state.json, then propose RESUME or RE-RUN.
rows.evidence: scan_chain_halt needs only the 'CHAIN HALT REPORT: <wave>' string (5417-5419). Searched 'classify_run_log' in verify_turn_compliance/verify_postconfig_complete/run_postconfig/postconfig_landing/preflight: none.

rows.rule: For a resume, verify the spec points at the checkpoint dir first.
rows.evidence: The resume dir is derived from wave+tag and --resume-from-checkpoint names it; a non-resume spec over an existing engine_state.json is refused (B3100, 436-441).

rows.rule: Relaunching a halted spec waits for the owner's word (CHECKLIST #120).
rows.evidence: A new chain HALTs on the old summary until the spec declares supersedes_summary, but that token is a 16-hex spec digest with no owner provenance. Searched 'owner.?word|launch_word' in launch-path scripts: none.

rows.rule: A HALT leaves a queue row naming the halted spec, the cause class and the relaunch command.
rows.evidence: scan_queue_not_updated accepts any added row or a NO-QUEUE-CHANGE line (3793-3833). Searched 'chain_halts|classify_run_log' in gate scripts: no row-content check.

rows.rule: Every HALT appends chain_halts.jsonl, toasts, and the turn cannot end without CHAIN HALT REPORT: <wave>.
rows.evidence: All five halt paths (run_serial_chain.py:331, 344, 350, 363, 385) call halt(); the Stop hook exits 2 until each unreported wave's report string appears.

rows.rule: A run that stopped non-COMPLETE is never auto-relaunched.
rows.evidence: The chain HALTs on its own non-COMPLETE summary and returns on any non-COMPLETE run_wave result (run_serial_chain.py:384-389); there is no retry path.

rows.rule: A same-name re-run is declared via supersedes_summary, never inferred.
rows.evidence: SKIPs only a COMPLETE summary carrying this chain_run_id; any other existing summary HALTs unless the spec's token equals its identity.

rows.rule: The supersedes token names the summary it replaces and cannot fire twice.
rows.evidence: The new summary's identity digests a spec containing the token, so they never match again; a stale token HALTs.

rows.rule: run_wave refuses to archive a COMPLETE Step-2 summary without the token.
rows.evidence: Exit 3, nothing archived, when a COMPLETE summary exists and the token is missing; recognises only specs declaring step 2.

rows.rule: A Step-2 re-run re-reads the holdout and needs the owner's word first.
rows.evidence: The token proves declaration, not owner consent; a renamed wave has no prior summary and is not refused. Searched 'owner.?word' in launch-path scripts and owner fields in make_spec: none.

rows.rule: Run identity is spec_digest of the authored spec, free-text notes excluded.
rows.evidence: sha256 of canonical JSON minus note/_doc/*_note/*_basis keys at top and arm level; every other key counts; run_wave stamps it on every summary (run_wave.py:761-790).

rows.rule: Grading is family-dispatched: the battery runs the family grader on every landing at the manifest's own parameters.
rows.evidence: FAMILIES entry for the manifest's graded strategy; knob values via params_from_manifest (516); an unregistered or unresolvable family is a FAIL (1350-1363).

rows.rule: A hand re-grade is the exception and uses the family's same grader.
rows.evidence: Searched 'hand.?grade|hand completion|graded_with' in verify_postconfig_complete/run_postconfig/postconfig_landing: only leg2_gap (130-163), catching a DONE step 2 missing its free-levels leg; nothing binds a hand grade to tools.grade.

rows.rule: The grader selects the best exit in-sample only.
rows.evidence: select_exit runs on IS metrics; 9 graders call it. test_b2628's fixture cannot tell IS from holdout selection (e1 wins both), so no behaviour test pins it.

rows.rule: Grade the holdout on the six gates via roster_core, the same bar as the Phase 1B roster.
rows.evidence: Graders and build_phase_1b_roster import the same evaluate and LIVE_GATES tuple.

rows.rule: The power floor (--min-n) is an early return before any gate, distinct from min_trades_holdout.
rows.evidence: Asserts evaluate returns None at n=8 with min_n 10, grades n=12 failing min_trades_holdout and passes at 15. The runbook's roster_core.py:215 citation is stale; the return is at line 223.

rows.rule: Render the locked PRODUCER_VARIANT_TABLE_<STRATEGY>.md artifact.
rows.evidence: Only the manual CLI writes it; postconfig_doc.py:530-536 says it is not a per-landing duty (landings render Tables C/D into POSTCONFIG_REPORT.md). Searched 'PRODUCER_VARIANT_TABLE_' in scripts and 'table_d(|table_c(' in run_postconfig.py.

rows.rule: --keys defaults to the family's own tools.grid_keys.
rows.evidence: Without --keys the family's SPECS tools.grid_keys are used, and a family declaring none is refused.

rows.rule: Never copy one family's keys onto another.
rows.evidence: An explicit --keys is split and used verbatim (7909). Searched 'grid_keys' in scripts (producer_variant_table, run_postconfig) and '--keys' handling in main: no membership check of passed keys against the family.

rows.rule: Advance the top 3 configs by the mechanical process: each config's best is_ci_lo, ranked descending, first three survivors.
rows.evidence: Pins only that the slate size reads 3 in three places. Searched 'step1_ranking[0]' and 'top.?3|slate|tie.?break' in scripts: no selector (make_spec sizing and renderers only).

rows.rule: Run the selection only when every Step-1 spec of the campaign is COMPLETE.
rows.evidence: make_spec.step2_sizing requires a COMPLETE Step-1 cube for THIS config only (make_spec.py:380-384). Searched 'step1_ranking[0]' and 'slate' in scripts: no campaign-wide completeness check.

rows.rule: Record the top-3 list, each with its is_ci_lo, in the queue row.
rows.evidence: scan_queue_not_updated accepts any row (3813-3815). Searched 'is_ci_lo|slate' in verify_turn_compliance.py (0 hits) and 'step1_ranking[0]' in scripts: no content check.

rows.rule: Skip a config whose best row duplicates a higher-ranked config's (is_ci_lo, is_sharpe, fires, exit) signature.
rows.evidence: Table D labels repeats in its dup column and drops nothing (producer_variant_table.py:6976-6982, 7061-7064). Searched 'Duplicate-signature|dup_signature' and 'step1_ranking[0]' in scripts: no slate builder applies the skip.

rows.rule: Resolve ordering ties by a tie-break the campaign records before ranking, never by sort order.
rows.evidence: Table D sorts by is_ci_lo then n (7016-7017), a sort-order rule; no spec or log field records a tie-break. Searched 'tie.?break' in scripts and 'tie-break the campaign records' in tests: none.

rows.rule: Read each slate row's tier and IS n before its rank.
rows.evidence: The renderer prints n and tier beside the key under a RANK IS NOT TRUSTWORTHINESS banner; the reading itself is a judgment step the runbook names.

rows.rule: Project each config's Step-2 cost from its own Step-1 duration x 10.88, never from the median.
rows.evidence: Sizes legs from the config's own Step-1 hours x the family's largest measured Step-2/Step-1 ratio, not 10.88; no owner cost table is generated. Searched '10.88|2.72|ticker.years' in scripts and 'PER CONFIG from its OWN' in tests: none.

rows.rule: Label the cost an estimate until the first cube lands.
rows.evidence: Searched 'ESTIMATE|estimate' in make_spec.py and '10.88|ticker.years' in scripts: no generated cost table or label check.

rows.rule: Record each campaign's slate and cost table in STRATEGY_CAMPAIGN_LOG.md.
rows.evidence: Searched 'STRATEGY_CAMPAIGN_LOG' in scripts (a post-fix exclusion list and build_strategy_status's reader only) and 'slate' in scripts: nothing writes or checks the entry; test_b2370 checks one historical SMC instance.

rows.rule: Configs run sequentially in the mechanical rank order.
rows.evidence: Pins three ordered <C1>-<C3> steps and the campaign log's slate text; run_serial_chain runs specs in whatever --specs order is typed and never compares it with a slate.

rows.rule: Each config runs in its entirety, all K cells graded, before any stop test.
rows.mechanism: run_postconfig family run over the whole cube, scripts/run_postconfig.py:1366-1368
rows.evidence: The battery grades the whole landed cube in one grader run; no mid-config stop logic exists in run_wave, run_serial_chain or run_postconfig.

rows.rule: If any cell of a config qualifies, stop: later configs are not run.
rows.evidence: Only the step text is pinned. run_serial_chain continues to the next spec after any COMPLETE wave and never reads qualifiers (run_serial_chain.py:384-389); searched 'waterfall' in scripts: comments only.

rows.rule: If config 3 also fails, terminate: the strategy closes NEGATIVE and the programme moves on.
rows.evidence: Step text pinned only; status_for derives CLOSED-NEGATIVE solely from the b2628 artifact (build_strategy_status.py:938-939), never from a waterfall result.

rows.rule: Never launch the slate in parallel or as one batch; a top-3 request launches config 1 and reports its verdict.
rows.evidence: launch_detached --chain accepts any number of Step-2 specs (209-263) and chains under other batch ids run concurrently. Searched 'step == 2|step2' in launch_detached.py and 'waterfall' in scripts: no restriction.

rows.rule: Qualification is PASS on all six LIVE_GATES; the 0.333 floor and ROBUST/PROVISIONAL split are retired.
rows.evidence: Fails if SELECTION_NOISE_FLOOR or robust_status returns or tighten_breaker_block assigns a status label; graders set PASS iff all(gates.values()) (tighten_breaker_block.py:381), unevaluable gates failing.

rows.rule: D2: no multiplicity correction across a config's graded cells.
rows.mechanism: grader verdict, scripts/tighten_breaker_block.py:381; bh_fdr_report report-only (test_b2815, test_unit.py:38740-38745)
rows.evidence: Verdicts are all(gates); BH-FDR is emitted as a report block and never enters qualification.

rows.rule: Size pool_workers on the Step 1.0 (b) commit reading, since commit is the binding quantity.
rows.evidence: make_spec writes pool_workers 4 unconditionally (make_spec.py:545); no gate compares pool_workers with a commit reading; scan_launch_missing_pool_workers exempts spec-driven launches (verify_turn_compliance.py:4964-4969).

rows.evidence: make_spec writes False and build_manifest defaults an absent field to False; test_b3093 (test_unit.py:44817-44821) also pins the template text in Step 2.2.

rows.mechanism: launch_sweep.drift_check / drift_allowed scripts/launch_sweep.py:199-282, 558-569; test_b3093 test_unit.py:44778; test_b3099_drift_check_is_content_aware test_unit.py:45782
rows.evidence: `if blocked and not m.get('allow_engine_drift')` -> refusal (:278); tests assert queue/doc/artifact commits pass while engine or per-leg-code commits refuse. Skipped only under the --engine-cmd test seam.

rows.rule: The landing battery runs once after the last leg from on-disk code, and the landing records the code that graded it (graded_with).

rows.evidence: Step 3 FAILs if M2/M3/M4/M5/M7 is absent or FAILs; M5 FAILs on any NaN/inf (:190-198). Winsorize beyond-count and the degraded map are disclosures only.

rows.rule: Step 6b: combinations differing only in a saturated parameter collapse into one equivalence class.
rows.evidence: N/A for single_combination families; DONE whenever a grid exists, quoting the grader's step1_distinct_outcomes; FAIL with no grid. The battery reports the collapse but does not verify it.

rows.rule: Step 7: every swept parameter reaches the engine as an actuated knob, proven by the family's engine_anchors (5.3 lines 1942-1947).
rows.evidence: Only params carrying an env knob are checked (knob_is_read + consumer drift + optional anchors script). Env-less swept params escape - e.g. institutional P7/P8 free_band levels graded offline every landing (producer_variant_table.py:477-498).

rows.rule: Step 8: the verdict is computed from the grid artifact with its N of M.
rows.evidence: DONE with combination/verdict counts or 'N of M exits RANKED' plus rank-1 ci_lo; OPEN with no grid or a NOT COMPARABLE ATR-proxy replay.

rows.rule: Step 2 has two legs - the family grader at manifest params and reproduction-gated free levels on this cube; either failing FAILs step 2.
rows.evidence: DONE only `if ok2 and okf`; the test asserts a free-leg failure FAILs step 2. Families declaring free_levels None (six declarations) run leg 1 only; leg2_gap blocks a hand DONE lacking the leg-2 artifact.

rows.rule: A new family's registration is incomplete without its free-levels grader (#290; also line 1829).
rows.evidence: _TOOLS_REQUIRED omits free_levels and family_refusal treats it as optional (run_postconfig.py:465, 501-503); validate_spec never ties a non-empty free_band to a free_levels script (producer_variant_table.py:5316-5497).

rows.rule: Every step ends DONE with evidence, N/A with a reason, FAIL or OPEN; SKIPPED is in no terminal set.
rows.evidence: Only DONE/N/A with non-empty evidence close a step; a SKIPPED or bare row makes the gate exit 2 and the Stop hook blocks (wired :6540).

rows.rule: FAIL and OPEN block completeness until a human dispositions the row with evidence; a config is not complete until all nine are DONE or N/A (THE RULE 1, line 1773).
rows.evidence: Incomplete legs exit 2, blocking every turn close; a battery live for under 2 h is exempt (:403-430). Hand-written evidence content is not validated.

rows.rule: A battery re-run never downgrades a terminal row and never truncates the evidence already on it.
